explanation: Series I converges absolutely by the ratio test, since the ratio is 1/(n+1)→0. Series II diverges by limit comparison with 1/√n, with ratio tending to 2. Series III diverges because its terms grow like n/2 and do not approach zero. Thus only I converges. This tests ordinary series convergence, a prerequisite absent from the supplied course topics; it does not test Fourier series or series solutions of ODEs.
